news.title: Father of suspect in Smyrna dismemberment case releases statement
news.summary: The father of an 18-year-old man charged with murder in Smyrna has released a statement pointing to his son's history of mental illness while police disclose new timeline details in the case.

news.title: Man shot during dispute in northwest Atlanta, police say
news.summary: A man is in the hospital after being shot early Saturday morning in northwest Atlanta following a dispute, according to police.

news.title: Police investigate after man found shot at Mechanicsville gas station
news.summary: A 60-year-old man is in the hospital after being found with a gunshot wound at a Mechanicsville gas station, according to police.

news.title: Man faces charges after SWAT response in Rockdale County, deputies say
news.summary: A man faces pending charges after triggering a SWAT response and a search on Friday night in Rockdale County, according to the sheriff's office.

news.title: Man found shot to death near Historic Fourth Ward Park, police say
news.summary: Atlanta police are investigating after a man was shot and killed early Saturday morning near the Historic Fourth Ward Park.

news.title: Metro Atlanta judge’s gun accidentally fires inside restaurant, police say
news.summary: A Clayton County Superior Court judge accidentally discharged a gun inside a restaurant earlier this month, according to police.

news.title: Boy killed in late-night southeast Atlanta shooting, police say
news.summary: A boy was killed late Friday night following a shooting in southeast Atlanta, according to police.

news.title: APD: Man found dead near Historic Fourth Ward Park
news.summary: The Atlanta Police Department said the man was found with an apparent gunshot wound. Homicide investigators are working to determine what happened.

news.title: 2 injured in shooting in Atlanta's West End neighborhood, police say
news.summary: Atlanta police are investigating a shooting that left two people injured in the historic West End neighborhood on Friday afternoon, according to authorities.

news.title: SWAT called after unauthorized family member enters Rockdale County home, sheriff says
news.summary: Deputies say the person was found with a weapon after a SWAT response and was taken to a hospital for evaluation. They will face charges after being released.

news.title: 15-year-old shot, killed in southeast Atlanta, police say
news.summary: Atlanta Police believe the deadly shooting was an isolated incident involving people who knew each other. The investigation remains ongoing.

news.title: Police share latest discovery in case after woman found dismembered in Smyrna; Man to face malice murder charge
news.summary: Kingston Bradley, who was already charged with concealing the death of another, will also be charged with malice murder, according to Smyrna Police.

news.title: Red Lobster standoff ends in arrest of man accused of sexually assaulting woman with disability over summer
news.summary: Police arrested Daryl Motley, of Easley, South Carolina after a standoff at the Red Lobster in Cartersville on Wed. night.

news.title: Cobb County deputy recovering after being attacked by murder suspect at detention center
news.summary: The deputy, whose identity was not released, was taken to a local hospital, where they are being treated for a broken jaw and a concussion.

news.title: Off-duty APD detective arrested for shoplifting beer, deputies say
